Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The umpires stride out to the field followed by the Pakistani players who take their positions on the field. Kusal Mendis and Pathuma Nissanka will open the innings for Sri Lanka and will be hoping to get off to a decent start. Mohammad Hasnain has been handed the new ball and he will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, this should be an easy run-chase for the in-form Sri Lankan batting lineup. They will want to come out and put on a professional performance. Pakistan need early wickets if they are to make an impact in this game. They would have seen what the Sri Lankan spinners did in the first innings and will look to repeat the same. Can Pakistan stage a comeback or will Sri Lanka breeze through this total? We will find out soon. Do join us for the run chase shortly.

Dhananjaya de Silva says that this was a good game to try out different combinations for the team, and he is happy that he got the chance and bowled well. He praises Maheesh Theekshana and Wanindu Hasaranga for their performances. Mentions that he thinks he has done enough to get a place in the final. Ends by saying that they have the quality in their batting to chase this total down.

Sri Lanka have absolutely dominated with the ball! They kept chipping away at the wickets and never let Pakistan settle into the game. The spinners seemed to be ruling proceedings as they kept it tight and wrecked through the Pakistan batting lineup. Wanindu Hasaranga was the pick of the bowlers taking three wickets for 21 runs in his four overs. Maheesh Theekshana and the debutant Pramod Madushan took two wickets each but all the bowlers did well to make this a complete performance. They will now hand over the baton to their batters to take the team home.

Pakistan came out with intent and unlike their usual game plan went after the bowlers from the word go. The plan backfired for them as they lost the in-form Mohammad Rizwan early. Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman returned to their original style and made a run-a-ball 35-run partnership. Once this partnership was broken, the wickets began to crumble and the more they looked to be aggressive the deeper they dug themselves into a mess. Mohammad Nawaz played a cameo of 26 to push them beyond 100 but they will know they are well short of a competitive total.

Pakistan's string lineup has completely crumbled and have not been able to bat out their 20 overs! Sri Lanka will be really proud of their bowling effort as they have not allowed Pakistan to get away with the game and bowled them out for a partly score of 121. They will be confident in chasing this target after completing much tougher chases prior to this.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan have been bowled out for 121! Pramod Madushan gets his second wicket of the match and is delighted. He bowls this slower, full and on middle, Haris Rauf stays there and tries to go over long on, but fails to pick the slower one and is through his slog early. As, a result the ball goes high in the air and Dhananjaya de Silva at long, settles under it, and completes an easy catch to end the Pakistan innigs. So, the target for Sri Lanka is 122.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Pramod Madushan

Commentary.Commentary: Nails the yorker again, on middle, Mohammad Hasnain manages to keep it out.
Mohammad Hasnain is the last batter out in the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! Mohammad Nawaz has to go back to the hut now. This is on a good length and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and sets off for the run, he calls for the second as he wants to keep the strike. Wanindu Hasaranga in the field is very quick to pick up the bowl and fires in a throw towards the keeper who takes the bails off in a flash as Nawaz puts in a desperate dive in. The umpires sends it upstairs to check, and the replay shows that Nawaz is well short of his crease. Pakistan nine down now.
SIX! BANG! This is full and on off, in the slot as well, Mohammad Nawaz stays there and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie. Nawaz is showing his batting qualities again here.
This is on a yorker length and on leg, Mohammad Nawaz squeezes it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good change of pace by Madushanka! He bowls this short and outside off, slower too, Mohammad Nawaz charges down but is too far away from the ball to connect. A dot!
Another full delivery, angling down the leg, Mohammad Nawaz misses his slog and gets hit on his pads as the ball dies on the pitch. Oh..no it is called No ball for overstepping. Free hit coming up...
Fuller one, on off, Haris Rauf drives it through cover for a single.
Short of length, around off. Mohammad Nawaz blocks it towards the bowler and a good spell by Maheesh Theekshana comes to an end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Maheesh Theekshana floats this one full and outside off, Usman Qadir goes for the slog but does not time the well. The ball flies high towards the long on fielder where Pathum Nissanka takes an easy catch. Usman Qadir needed to rotate the strike and get Mohammad Nawaz on strike but he was looking for glory. Has to make the long walk back and is replaced by Haris Rauf at the crease.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, and quicker this time. Mohammad Nawaz hits it down the ground straight towards the fielder at long on.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this a touch shorter and wide outside off, Mohammad Nawaz cuts this straight to point.
SIX! That is a great shot. Maheesh Theekshana bowls fuller, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz goes over deep extra cover for a maximum. That is a classic shot by Nawaz.
On a length and on middle, Usman Qadir forces it towards long on for single.
FOUR! A much needed boundary for Pakistan! This is a slower one, full and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz clears his front leg and lofts it over mid-off for a lovely boundary. 100 up for Pakistan.
A good yorker, on leg, Usman Qadir digs it towards mid on for a single.
Sharp bouncer! This is banged short, on middle and leg, Usman Qadir ducks under it.
Short of a length and on middele, Mohammad Nawaz pulls it with his inner half towards deep square leg for a run.

Chance of a run out, but he misses the stumps! This is on a length again and on off, Usman Qadir knocks it towards short mid-wicket and sets off for the run, the fielder picks up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit and he would have been miles out, but Qadir gets the run.
Starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Usman Qadir pushes it towards the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maheesh Theekshana bowls it quicker and around off. Hasan Ali tries to clear the longer boundary of the ground but didn't time it well and Wanindu Hasaranga takes a simple catch at deep mid-wicket. Pakistan are losing their way here in a bid to accelerate. Usman Qadir makes his way out to the middle now.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on middle, Hasan Ali reveres sweeps it but straight to point.
WIDE! Darts this one down the leg, Hasan Ali misses his scoop. Wided.
Short of length, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz knocks it towards deep cover for a single.
A bit short and outside off, turning away, Mohammad Nawaz slaps it towards deep point for a brace.
Short, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz tries to sweep that one but misses it completely and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Mohammad Nawaz blocks it back to the bowler.

OUT! BOWLED! That was a beauty! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls a googly outside off. Asif Ali looks to defend it on the front foot but he was beaten all ends up as the ball goes on to crash against the stumps. Asif Ali goes back to the shed without troubling the scorers. Pakistan is in some serious trouble here as Hasan Ali walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! What a comeback from Hasaranga! He slows this one up, fuller and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed again tries to go for a big slog over mid-wicket but plays through his shot a bit too early, the ball goes through, hits his back pad, and crashes onto the stumps. Asif Ali makes his way out to the middle.
SIX! First maximum of the day! That was short, around off. Iftikhar Ahmed goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region and Pakistan is now looking to shift the gears.
Shorter in length and on off, Iftikhar Ahmed goes on his back foot and pushes it towards short mid off.
Lofted ball, outside off. Mohammad Nawaz knocks it towards point for a quick single.
Floated, short and on leg, Mohammad Nawaz goes down and paddle sweeps it towards short fine leg.
Fuller length, on off. Mohammad Nawaz pushes it towards long off for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva serves this one full and angling into the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! The spinners are right on top of the Pakistan batters here! Khushdil Shah holes out in an attempt to push the scoring. Dhananjaya de Silva flights this one full and outside off, Khushdil Shah charges down the wicket and goes for the heave but manages to slice this high towards long on. Pathum Nissanka judges the ball really well and grabs hold of it. Khushdil Shah has to depart and Pakistan are four down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Dhananjaya de Silva

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller length, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed goes hard at the ball towards long off but the fielder in the deep stops it and just a single is conceded.
Dhananjaya de Silva fires this one full and angling down leg, Khushdil Shah shimmies down the wicket and looks to work this leg side. Gets a leading edge to long off for a single.
Swing and a miss. Maheesh Theekshana bowls this quicker through the air and just outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to go big towards mid-wicket but misses it.
Fires this one full and angled into the pads, Khushdil Shah attempts the reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg as they take a leg bye.
Short, outside off. Khushdil Shah plays it straight towards mid off.
Goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and gets the ball to come back in from off stump, Khushdil Shah gets cramped for space and the ball hits him high on the pads.
Quicker delivery, short in length. Iftikhar Ahmed plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana begins with a full delivery straying onto the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits the pad and rolls towards short fine leg. Khushdil Shah refuses the run.
Maheesh Theekshana is back on. He conceded 8 runs in his first over.
Short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed knocks it towards long off for a single.
Bowls this one a touch shorter and just outside off, Iftikhar Ahmed stands tall and blocks the ball back towards the bowler.
On a good length, around middle. Kusal Mendis plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats this one full and drifting into the pads, Iftikhar Ahmed flicks this towards deep mid-wicket for another run.
Fuller length, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed looks to work it towards mid-wicket but gets a leading edge and the ball just falls short of the cover fielder.
Bowls this full and angles this into the batter, Khushdil Shah clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
Short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed goes on the back foot and plays it towards the bowler.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Khushdil Shah clips this to wide long on and takes a run to get off the mark.

FIVE WIDES! Wanindu Hasaranga gets the ball to turn sharply as he serves this full and pitching outside leg, Khushdil Shah looks to sweep but misses and the keeper is unable to collect this. Given five wides by the umpire and Wanindu Hasaranga looks miffed. He feels there was bat on this.
Khushdil Shah is the next man in for Pakistan.

OUT! BOWLED! The break has worked in favour of Sri Lanka as the plan from Pakistan to go on the attack backfired as they lose their skipper. The backbone of Pakistan, Babar Azam departs. This was the traditional leg spinner, fuller and quicker through the air, on middle. Babar Azam dances down the pitch and tries to slog it over mid-wicket but misses it as it just straightens enought to beat him. The ball goes through and shatters the stumps. Wanindu Hasaranga strikes big and Babar Azam's struggle in the middle ends.
Floats this one full and in line with the stump, Iftikhar Ahmed clips the ball to the left of the diving mid-wicket fielder and they take a single.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Babar Azam drives it through covers for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga flights this one full and outside the off stump, Babar Azam strokes this to the cover fielder.

Drinks! Pakistan started their innings pretty aggressively but could not continue the momentum. Babar Azam is still there but is struggling to find his timing. Sri Lanka will be happy with their performance upto now. The debutant, Pramod Madushan got a wicket in his very first over when he got rid of Mohammad Rizwan. Pakistan need to change gears now to get to decent total. Wanindu Hasaranga to continue after the break.
Short, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed tries to work it toward offside but misses it and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam clips this to long on and takes another single.
On a good length, outside off. Iftikhar Ahmed pushes it towards the deep point for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne pulls his length back a fraction and bowls this outside off, Babar Azam knocks this down to long on for a single.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chamika Karunaratne bowls this slower, outside off. Fakhar Zaman looks to go hard over the extra cover region but Wanindu Hasaranga in the deep pouches an easy catch and the strings of low scores continue for Fakhar Zaman.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: Chamika Karunaratne bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Babar Azam gets across the stumps and wrists the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne comes into the attack now.
Short, outside off. Babar Azam knocks it towards deep cover for a single.
Fourth dot ball in a row! Wanindu Hasaranga flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam works this to the right of the bowler but he dives and stops the ball once again.
Yorker ball, onto the stumps. Babar Azam digs it towards short mid-wicket.
Bowls this full and just outside off, Babar Azam taps this to the right of the bowler, Wanindu Hasaranga dives to his right and stops the ball.
Flighted one, around off. Babar Azam pushes it towards cover for no run.
Wanindu Hasaranga begins the over with a googly served a fraction short and going away from the left-hander. Fakhar Zaman taps the ball towards cover and takes a run.
Dhananjaya de Silva bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam flicks this towards deep mid-wicket and they run well to complete two runs.
A bit short and on middle, Fakhar Zaman looks to go for the big slog but adjsuts according to the length and tucks it away through square leg for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Babar Azam drives it to long off for an easy single.

Sloppy fielding from Sri Lanka! This is flighted, short and on off, Babar Azam pushes with his inner half towards short fine leg and sets off for the run, the fielder throws at the bowler's end where de Silva cannot collect and the batters get an extra run.
Darts in a yorker, on middle, Fakhar Zaman digs it out towards mid on for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Fakhar Zaman blocks it out.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Babar Azam uses his feet and drills it wide of long on where the fielder dives to his right to stop it. Two runs taken.
A googly, short and on middle, turning away, Fakhar Zaman stays back and punches it wide of point for a run.
Bowls this a touch short and outside the off stump, Fakhar Zaman mistimes his shot back to the bowler.
Flights this full and just outside off, Fakhar Zaman blocks the ball back towards the bowler.
Flighted and on middle, Fakhar Zaman pushes it to the right of the bowler where Hasaranga dives and stops it.
A bit short and outside off, Babar Azam cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga has been brought into the attack now that the Powerplay is over.

Oh..that was close! This is slower one, on a length and on leg, Fakhar Zaman looks to make room and but instead gets cramped and blocks it out onto the ground. The ball hits the ground and goes onto kiss the stumps. However, the bails remains intact and Fakhar Zaman gets lucky this time. Pakistan are 49/1 after the Powerplay.
Goes fuller and on middle, Babar Azam knocks it towards mid on for a quick single.

EDGY BUT FOUR! This is on a good length and around the fifth stump line, Babar Azam stays in his crease and looks to drive away from his body. He only manages to get a thick outside edge and the ball flew past the first slip for a boundary.
Full again and on leg, Fakhar Zaman tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller one, on middle, Fakhar Zaman looks to heave it but did not get any timing at all. The ball runs away wide of the deep square leg fielder as the batters runs two.
FOUR! Powered away! This is a freebie, full toss and around off, Fakhar Zaman stays there and smashes it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
A single to end the over as this full ball is driven to long off.
Flatter, a bit short and on middle, Fakhar Zaman goes to blocks it but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a muted appeal for a LBW but turned down.
Quicker one, on middle, Babar Azam eases it towards long on for a run.
Looped up, full and on middle, Fakhar Zaman uses his feet, but mistimes his slog badly towards long on for a single.
Floated and down the leg, Fakhar Zaman looks to block it but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
Starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on middle, Fakhar Zaman flicks it uppishly wide of short mid-wicket.
Dhananjaya de Silva replaces Dilshan Madushanka.
This is on a good length as well and headed straight for the stumps, Babar Azam clips this towards deep mid-wicket and they take easy two runs. End of a successful over for the debutant.
Pramod Madushan pulls his length back a fraction and gets the ball to angle into the batter. Babar Azam gets on top of this and tucks the ball past the mid-wicket fielder for a brace.

Pramod Madushan bowls this on a good length and angled into the stumps, Babar Azam looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge just over the cover fielder and they take a couple of runs. Could have been two in two.
Fakhar Zaman walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT!  Pramod Madushan draws first blood on his debut! Bowls this a touch short and in line with the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan goes for the pull but is in no position to do so. Manages to get a top edge that flies high to the left of the keeper. Kusal Mendis makes no mistake as he takes a comforatble catch. Pakistan seem to have come out agressive and they want to try a different approach here.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Pramod Madushan

Commentary.Commentary: Poor from Sri Lanka in the field. They need to pick up their game here. Pramod Madushan bowls this full and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan strokes this hard towards mid off. A misfield allows this to take a couple of runs as the ball rolls towards long off.
WIDE! That is a poor delivery! Bowls this full and way outside the off pole. The umpire raises his arms to the side and indicates this is wide.
Pramod Madushan begins with a good length delivery just outside off, Mohammad Rizwan taps the ball towards point.
Pramod Madushan comes into the attack on his debut. He was given the T20I debut cap by Chamika Karunaratne before the match.
Similar delivery and keeps Babar Azam tucked up. He manages to defend this towards mid-wicket.
Delivers this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam blocks this back towards the bowler.
Dilshan Madushanka bowls a lovely bouncer well directed at the batter. Babar Azam sways out of the way.
Dilshan Madushanka goes a touch fuller and outside the off pole, Babar Azam strokes this firmly towards mid off.
Dilshan Madushanka bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Babar Azam knocks this straight to cover-point.
Dilshan Madushanka strays well down leg and the keeper is unable to get to this. The ball runs away to the boundary and the umpire indicates a wide and four extra runs.
Dilshan Madushanka bowls this full and just outside off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to push at this but gets a thick edge towards third man for a single.
Bowls this one much quicker and into the pads, Mohammad Rizwan tucks this to short fine leg and takes one to keep strike.
Maheesh Theekshana goes full and into the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan looks to heave but gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a brace.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this a touch shorter and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan pulls this to deep square leg and takes a couple of runs.
WIDE! Gets the ball to turn down leg side. Kusal Mendis collects the ball and whips the bails. Mohammad Rizwan falls over but keeps his foot inside. The umpire calls this wide.
This is quicker in the air and bowls this full in line with the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan blocks this towards mid-wicket.
Bowls this one just outside off on a fuller length, Babar Azam uses his wrists and works the ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana starts off with a full delivery on the pads, Mohammad Rizwan flicks this towards deep square leg and take a run.
Dasun Shanaka is going with spin straightaway as he brings Maheesh Theekshana into the attack.

FOUR! That is a cracking shot to end the over! Dilshan Madushanka goes full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam shows a straight bat and thumps back past the bowler for a straight boundary. Pakistan have begun with a different approach in this game as they take 11 runs off the first over.
Bowls this on short and wide outside off, Mohammad Rizwan gets on top of this and taps the ball towards point for a run.
WIDE! Straying down leg this time on a good length. The keeper, Kusal Mendis is unable to collect this and they run an extra wide run.
This is on a good length and pitching on leg, Mohammad Rizwan tucks this towards square leg and takes a single.

Dilshan Madushanka tempts the batter with a full delivery just outside off and takes some pace off the ball. Hits the ball just short of mid off and they get two runs as the fielder is unable to stop the ball.

Goes full and in line with the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan keeps his head steady and clips the ball through mid-wicket. They take two runs as the fielder stops the ball just before the boundary, This will be just one run though as Babar Azam has run one shot.
Dilshan Madushanka begins with a fuller length delivery angling away from the right-hander from well outside off. Mohammad Rizwan goes for the expansive drive straight up but gets beaten.

We are finally ready for the start of the game! We can see the Sri Lankan players in a huddle. The star opening pair of Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are walking out to the middle. Dilshan Madushanka to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...
We are moments away from the game! But, before that it is time for the national anthems. The national of anthem of Pakistan will be up first followed by Sri Lanka's national anthem.

Mohammad Nawaz says that they recovered from the last game and it was easy because they won it. Adds that he has been working in the nets and that showed on the pitch. Mentions that it is not about how you start but ending well is the goal. Ends by saying that he considers himself a bowling all-rounder at the moment as most of his good performances have come in the bowling department, but he is working hard on his batting too and hopes to score more runs for the team.

Pitch Report - Sanjay Manjrekar says that it is a duplicate of the pitch from the previous day. Informs that they can back Babar Azam to get runs in this game. Mentions that wrist spinners will have a role to play in this game. Adds that there may not be much in it for Hasan Ali and that he expects the top 3 to score the majority of the runs.  Goes on to say that the spinners can hopefully show there is turn in the wicket. Ends by saying that there are dry patches between the grass and that could definitely help the spinners.

Babar Azam the skipper of Pakistan says that they would have bowled first as well but now that they are batting they want to put pressure by getting runs on the board. Informs that they have 2 changes as well. Adds that they are just resting Shadab Khan and Naseem Shah since they have back-to-back games. Adds that they wanted to try a different combination.

Dasun Shanaka the captain of Sri Lanka says they will bowl first. Smiles and adds that the toss has always gone their side. Mentions that it will be really good to face Pakistan for the first time before going to the final as they will be able to test their strength. Informs that they have 2 changes and both the changes are done to be able to check their bench strength.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Asif Ali, Hasan Ali (In for Naseem Shah), Haris Rauf, Usman Qadir (In for Shadab Khan), Mohammad Hasnain.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva (In for Charith Asalanka), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Pramod Madushan (In for Asitha Fernando & On Debut), Dilshan Madushanka.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and they have decided to BOWL first.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! We are here for the last game of the Super Four stage in the Asia Cup, 2022. Remember when we used to play a trial ball in gully cricket before the start of a game? This match is something like that only, as Sri Lanka will be up against Pakistan. We know that the final will also be played between these two, and this match serves as a nice 'trail game' for them.
